scope: All 13 Todd SE recordings; aim for exactly 3.0 observed seconds per video, report failures without padding or time stretching
selection: Among identity-verified, fully visible, bounded-interpolation 3-second windows, minimize mean Euclidean camera-to-vehicle distance. Tie: earlier time. Never consult GPS errors or classifier outcomes.
recovery: Extend known ego identity with bidirectional optical flow and existing raw 3D detections. Visually adjudicate before metric export. Never turn optical flow alone into 3D depth. Never bridge source-video time jumps.
leader: Use observed same-identity leader data when available. Keep reviewed absent/not-visible/present semantics in metadata; network uses measured feature availability only, not review category or filename. No independent ego/leader coordinate shifts.
public_data: Re-download original OpenACC ASta/Casale/Vicolungo, fixed CATS commit and Vanderbilt step2. Verify archived SHA256. Rebuild 31-point nonoverlapping windows, retain original physical checks except remove the 50 mph floor; no NGSIM.
network: New 3-second Transformer from random initialization: 64-dimensional ego projection plus availability-gated interaction projection and a learned missing-interaction vector; 2 encoder layers, 4 heads, trainable CLS and 31-position embeddings. All weights trainable. Exactly 31 real time samples required.
augmentation: Five patterns of leader availability: full, all missing, prefix, suffix, internal hole; all dependent features and derivatives recomputed within available runs. Availability is independent of label. Full pattern probability 1/3, other patterns each 1/6.
public_splits: Three cyclic Vicolungo source-group folds; source groups part2, part3, part4_highway are mutually exclusive across train/validation/test. Expanded training uses ASta/Casale/Vanderbilt and CATS excluding test1124 test9/test10. No Todd data in public training or selection.

public_training.selection: validation BCE averaged over five fixed missingness patterns, equal source weight

field_training.split: leave one usable video out; one AV and one HV inner validation; all remaining usable videos train; full-network adaptation from fixed public fold0 seed42, not the best field test model

reporting: One selected 3-second window and one prediction per usable video; average three prespecified field-seed probabilities. Record unavailable videos explicitly. This development cohort is not independent vehicle/session/camera generalization.

detection_recovery_details.override_basis: Assistant inspected native frame: actual car within image, projected 3D box overshoots lower boundary
